claims.question: q2
claims.claim: In large-scale cloud service platforms, thousands of customer tickets are generated daily and are typically handled through on-call dialogues, imposing a substantial workload on human support analysts.
claims.quote: In large-scale cloud service platforms, thousands of customer tickets are generated daily and are typically handled through on-call dialogues. This high volume of on-call interactions imposes a substantial workload on human support analysts.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Vigil has been deployed on Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud platform, for over ten months, and evaluations based on this deployment demonstrate effectiveness and practicality.
claims.quote: Vigil has been deployed on Volcano Engine, ByteDance's cloud platform, for over ten months, and comprehensive evaluations based on this deployment demonstrate its effectiveness and practicality.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Vigil operates throughout the on-call life cycle and focuses on assisting during the phase when human support is already involved.
claims.quote: Unlike reactive agents, Vigil focuses on providing assistance during the phase in which human support is already involved.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Vigil integrates into the customer-analyst dialogue and proactively offers assistance without explicit user invocation.
claims.quote: It integrates into the dialogue between the customer and the analyst, proactively offering assistance without explicit user invocation.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: Vigil uses a continuous self-improvement mechanism that extracts knowledge from human-resolved cases to autonomously update its capabilities.
claims.quote: Moreover, Vigil incorporates a continuous self-improvement mechanism that extracts knowledge from human-resolved cases to autonomously update its capabilities.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: Reactive support agents are typically disengaged when issues are escalated to human support, preventing them from following up, tracking resolution progress, or learning from failed cases.
claims.quote: However, when issues remain unresolved and are escalated to human support, these agents are typically disengaged. As a result, they cannot assist with follow-up inquiries, track resolution progress, or learn from the cases they fail to address.
